results.name: Legend of the Hidden Buddha
results.description:
This 3D model represents the standing statue of Amida Nyorai, enshrined at Jizō Hall in Mie, Japan. The temple dates back to the 8th century and has long been a place of faith for local villagers.

In the 1600s, a fire destroyed the temple and most of its statues. The Amida statue went missing and was believed to be lost. Years later, a villager had a dream in which the statue spoke:
"I rest in the valley—bring me home."

Guided by the dream, the villagers searched the nearby mountains. Amazingly, they found the statue unharmed in a rocky cave. It was returned and enshrined once more, becoming a powerful symbol of faith and miracle.

This model was created as part of the Tokiwatari Project, which digitally preserves cultural and sacred sites across rural Japan.

Explore the statue in 3D and let its story inspire you.

Discover more 3D models, stories, and cultural projects from the region at
🌐https://tokiwatari.jp/site/toukouji/

results.name: Two sets of Amitabha Triad (japan)
results.description:
# 仁井田双式来迎三尊図像摩崖仏  
Period/Century : Kamakura period, dated 1329 (Karyaku 4)  
To place Amida Nyorai(Amitabha) in the center for the religion, and place Kannon Bosatsu(Avalokitesvara) and Seishi Bosatsu(Mahasthamaprapta) on both sides of Amida Nyorai, the form is called Amitabha Triad. Amida Nyorai a Buddha leading the dead to paradise.Kannon Bosatsu represents "mercy" of Buddha, and Seishi Bosatsu represents "wisdom" of Boddha.  
This is a priceless cultural treasure because two pieces of Amitabha Triad are carved on the rocky wall and you can see nothing else like these in Japan.

![Image from Gyazo](https://i.gyazo.com/545c8370f65eef998b819270f2c8dc73.jpg)

results.description: Bought by Scottish merchant and landowner James Douglas Fletcher in 1902, possibly from a London-based retailer. It stood in the garden of his Rosehaugh estate near Avoch until 1954, when his widow died, and the statue was sold to National Museums Scotland.

results.name: Amidamaru Spirit Form (Shaman King Fanart)
results.description:
We're currently watching the remake of the anime Shaman King, and even though it is targeted to a younger audience I love the attitude of most characters. So obviously I had to do a little practice, and recreated Amidamaru in his Spiritform.

While I sticked to references for basic-attributes, I wanted to give it my own touch with the details. The model is downloadable for free and Includes:
- [Hair/Fire Shader](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3m0JkeK4m8E)
- [Ghibli Style Rock Shader](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FHeBI5tAGP0)

Both shaders didn't really work on Sketchfab, but if you swap out the "Emission" with the Node-Tree in the Shading-Tab you'll get colors like [this]( https://www.artstation.com/artwork/qQvBq2) - you'll figure it out ;)

💖 If you wanna see more art from me, make sure to stop by on [my other platforms](https://linktr.ee/dramera_cg)
